meta.title: Make PR to deactivate thinking field
meta.body_summary: Add use_thinking option to browser-use agent to disable the thinking field, reducing token usage and providing more concise output when detailed reasoning is not required.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added optional thinking field reducing token count; cursor bot detected bugs (safety logic removal, tag mismatch) that were fixed iteratively; merged without human review or benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1031 changed lines across 8 files, this is a medium-sized feature addition. Most churn (396 lines) is in a summary document that was later removed, while the core logic changes are moderate. The merge is consistent with a non-breaking feature that reduces token usage, approved after automated reviews found no critical issues.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] flagged removal of safety logic in multi_act and inconsistent system message tags (<system> vs <s>). These were fixed by maintainer and agent in subsequent commits until final bot review reported no bugs.
review_details.performance_claim: Adds use_thinking flag to drop the thinking field, reducing token usage for LLM calls.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Modifying agent output schemas and system prompts requires careful handling of parsing and state management; Cursor successfully implemented the feature but introduced unrelated regressions (safety logic, tag format) that were caught by automated review and fixed iteratively.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] performed static analysis that detected two bugs: accidentally removed safety state-checking logic and mismatched system message tags between prompt files and message manager.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after token counts or benchmark; only narrative claim of token reduction. CI task evaluation (1/3) did not directly validate performance.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer committed fixes targeting the bot-flagged bugs (commit b3e83d6 etc.), and agent contributed type-hint improvements. Final bot check confirmed no remaining issues.

core_change_summary.description: Added use_thinking boolean to AgentSettings; created system_prompt_no_thinking.md; made thinking field optional in AgentBrain/AgentOutput; added type_with_custom_actions_no_thinking static method; updated SystemPrompt to load alternative prompt and MessageManager to conditionally include thinking; adjusted logging/serialization to handle optional thinking.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: THINKING_FIELD_OPTIONAL_PR_SUMMARY.md was a temporary summary document later removed; eval/judge_system.py came from a main-merge and is unrelated.
change_trajectory: Initial agent commits: implemented optional thinking field, added summary doc.
Maintainer 'Fix' commit removed summary doc and made minor adjustments.
Subsequent agent commits refined type hints and removed PlannerPrompt inheritance.
Multiple cursor[bot] reviews flagged bugs (safety logic, tag mismatch) that were resolved in later commits.
Final formatting fixes; merged after bot gave all-clear.

review_signals.summary: BugBot reported that safety logic (checking for new DOM elements after multi-action) was removed, risking stale DOM interactions.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer committed fixes that restored safety logic or addressed the issue.

review_signals.summary: BugBot found system message tag inconsistency between system_prompt_no_thinking.md (using <system>) and updated files using <s>.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed by harmonizing tags in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: cubic reviewed 6 files and found no issues.
Agent task evaluation passed 1/3 (amazon_laptop pass; browser_use_pip and captcha_cloudflare fail).
review_signals.action_taken: Merge proceeded despite low pass rate.

review_signals.summary: Final BugBot review found no bugs before merge.
No security or compliance issues detected.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent opened the PR with optional thinking feature around 12:40.
Two bot reviews (cursor, cubic) and CI evaluation appeared within minutes.
Cursor bot flagged bugs: safety logic removal and tag mismatch.
Maintainer triggered bugbot runs and committed fixes over the next 1.5 hours.
Agent added type-hint and inheritance refactor commits.
After final 'fix format?' commits and a last BugBot all-clear at 16:12, PR merged at 16:25.
